source: ESA SNAP CalibrationOp, S1-TAS-MEPS-0022, eopf S1 L12 ATBD eq 6.3-6.4
grd_specific: GRD products are multi-looked in azimuth; the calibration LUT accounts for the effective number of looks and the antenna pattern. No additional processing-specific correction is needed beyond the LUT.
constant_role: The absolute calibration constant (0.8995) is ALREADY incorporated in the sigmaNought LUT values provided in the product XML. Our code does NOT apply it separately. No double-application.
